title: Review of lab 1's ad5-evolve (IDH): on fresh seed 23 derived catalyst alleles come to dominate 6 of 8 droplets by t=17600 against 1 of 11 in the equal-rate neutral twin, and fast-allele droplets divide into same-kind daughters; but most derived droplets arise by in-place conversion of an ancestral droplet after a mutation patch, not by births, so H is weak
summary: Ran threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad5-evolve/world.py and its neutral twin ad5n-neutral (all four alleles k=0.13, otherwise identical) on unused seed 23 (labkit, T=20000), and counted droplets by dominant allele every 25 frames (alleles.py). Evolve: 5 planted a0 droplets; derived alleles appear at frame 76 and reach [a0..a3] = [2, 4, 1, 2] at frame 151 and [2, 2, 2, 2] at 176; labkit 3 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges. Neutral twin: [11, 0, 1, 0] at frame 176, 5 persistent splits, generation 2. The sheet shows two routes: ancestral droplets turning colour in place (one at t~5200-6900, several at t~12100-13100) after mutation patches, and derived (blue, a3-like) droplets pinching into two blue daughters (t~13900-19200).

observations.D: ad5-evolve/seed23/lineage.png: 3 persistent splits, generation 2; sheet t=13900-19200: blue droplets pinch into blue daughters
observations.H: results.txt: derived alleles dominate 6/8 droplets (frame 176) vs 1/11 in the neutral twin; derived daughters keep the parent's allele

seeds_run.result: derived alleles rise above the neutral twin, mostly by in-place conversion

controls_run.H: ad5n-neutral/seed23 (all alleles k=0.13, same mutation and dilution): derived 1/11 droplets at frame 176

verdicts.limitation: Planted founders (no S). The rise of derived alleles is carried mainly by conversions: a mutation patch is an imposed transplant of a disk of another allele into a droplet, and a droplet that switches allele in place is a change of kind along one track, not selection among offspring. Divisions are few (3-5 persistent per run), the only deaths are imposed dilution disks, and the neutral twin's droplets are faster than the evolve run's ancestor (k 0.13 vs 0.10), so the twin is not matched on demography. One seed.
